name: bluetooth-connector-video
description: Marketplace promo video for the Bluetooth Device Connector Stream Deck plugin

scripts.render: npm run render:raw && ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i out/promo-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af volume=12dB -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart out/promo.mp4
scripts.marketplace:video: remotion render BluetoothPromo out/promo-marketplace-raw.mp4 --crf=20 && ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i out/promo-marketplace-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af volume=12dB -c:a aac -b:a 192k -movflags +faststart ../marketplace/promo.mp4
scripts.marketplace: npm run marketplace:hero && npm run marketplace:inspector && npm run marketplace:thumbnail && npm run marketplace:video
